question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Enigmatic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"enigmatic"** means something that is mysterious and difficult to understand. (रहस्यमय)

 
 
• **Example:** The Mona Lisa's smile is **enigmatic**, leaving many viewers wondering about its true meaning.
 
 
 
• **"Obvious"** refers to something that is easily perceived or understood; clear and apparent. (स्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example:** It was **obvious** that he was lying because he couldn't maintain eye contact.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'enigmatic'** is **'obvious'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Puzzling** (उलझन): Causing confusion or perplexity.

 
 
• **Example:** The directions were so puzzling that we got lost several times.
 
 
 
• **Pretentious** (दिखावटी): Attempting to impress by affecting greater importance or merit than is actually possessed.
 
 
• **Example:** His pretentious attitude made him unpopular among his peers.
 
 
 
• **Stumping** (चकरा देने वाला): Causing one to be unable to answer a question or solve a problem.
 
 
• **Example:** The tricky riddle stumped even the brightest students in the class.
